name: Azeroth Companion
title: Performance Overdrive & Intelligence Refinement
features: Added an adaptive Talent Forge visual performance selector: Auto for smaller/reduced-motion environments, Full for original effects, and Lite for lower-cost tree decorations.
Reduced initial rendering work in Character Intelligence by displaying Blizzard-returned equipment records in batches of sixteen, with an option to load further results.
Equipment list rendering now builds rows with a document fragment and resets its batch safely when sorting or loading another character.
Performance preferences are isolated from saved builds and character data; Talent Forge allocation logic, item IDs, music, authentication and all Blizzard integrations remain unchanged.
Release includes static regression checks for new assets and batch rendering; real-player testing and device benchmarks will follow when testers are available.
